title: database_connectivity_and_schema_health
description: Verify that backend database connection is healthy, MySQL connection pool is responsive, and GET /api/health confirms active database connectivity without timeouts.

title: database_financial_transactions_persistence_and_calculations
description: Verify database CRUD operations on financial transactions ledger: inserting donations via POST /api/transactions/public-donate, calculating cashflow aggregation via GET /api/transactions/summary, and ensuring decimal precision.

title: database_relational_integrity_and_jemaah_records
description: Verify relational integrity in the jemaah table: self-registration via POST /api/jemaah/public-register, category aggregation via GET /api/jemaah/summary, and foreign key relations with users.

title: database_work_program_lifecycle_and_state_persistence
description: Verify persistence of work programs lifecycle in the database: public summary via GET /api/programs/summary, iCal feed generation from database records via GET /api/programs/feed.ics, and status tracking.

title: database_inventaris_and_settings_storage
description: Verify database persistence for asset inventory and system configurations: GET /api/inventaris/summary and GET /api/settings returning stored configuration and counts from MySQL.
